notes.title: KONOSUBA! OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]🚨[b]KONOSUBA – God’s Blessing on this Wonderful World! Love For These Clothes of Desire! Is OUT NOW![/b]🚨
[/h1]
Check out the launch trailer here👇👇
[previewyoutube=8Qkfc3HTWng;full][/previewyoutube]
Join Kazuma and the girls in this visual novel as they discover a mysterious ‘black slab’ that when used triggers a curse, causing a complete personality flip! The only way to break this curse is by fulfilling the body and soul of the flipped personality's new desires✨
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/1e814126acb60596e2ba8ef54cdd45a7b98a8296.jpg[/img]
Task the party with part-time jobs and send them on quests to find the needed ingredients in order to craft outfits on the slab, to both create curse-breaking costumes, and save them from getting kicked out of Axel!🫢
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/c16088dbed700827ae1784f89e9e29f37acaaee5.jpg[/img]
Are you ready to create heart-pounding outfits and play dress-up with unexpected twists and turns!💃
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/6284dbe177cd637626d0ee64d09a3d21899f09b6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/b15165fa2c90867a54760eef7266aaf981448157.jpg[/img]

notes.title: COMING FEBRUARY 8TH 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/9b268e8efe1e4c2ec4c4fac575f0dd2b58f8487f.jpg[/img]

Konosuba - God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Love for these Clothes of Desire! Will be coming on Thursday 8th February 2024! 

[previewyoutube=QGS46TtxRfo;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring the hit characters from the series! Its nearly time for a new Konosuba story in Visual Novel Form.

Follow Kazuma and the girls as they discover a mysterious ‘black slab' which unleashes a curse, causing  their personalities to flip. Assign the party to part time jobs and send them out on quests in order to find specific ingredients needed to make outfits on the slab, in order to break the curses!

Unravel the story by making decisions, putting the party to work, managing recourses and building up affections! 

Don't miss out the opportunity to be one of the first to experience the ONLY Konosuba localised visual Novel!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/b215560f0d1d8d23b959d6fc5e4276a3b70f0305.gif[/img]

[h2][u][b]Watch our exclusive playthrough now![/b][/u]
[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349140/KONOSUBA__Gods_Blessing_on_this_Wonderful_World_Love_For_These_Clothes_Of_Desire/
